title: Synthetic Ascension domestic gardens v1
status: Garden handoff closed: both overhead tree v2 and flower/herb bed provisionally kept by lead as sources suitable for integration testing. No native/fit/final aesthetic acceptance.
scope: Two logical garden assets: original tree and bed plus one explicitly requested targeted tree projection edit. Three preserved raster files total; two initial built-in generations and one built-in edit, no further variations.

coordinate_convention.alpha_threshold_note: Thresholds are measurements only, not altered files. Raw alpha>0 bounds include faint residue and must not be used as placement/collision bounds.

references.role: Accepted temperate palette, city/material language and daylight; simplify over-lined detail and depth.
Existing painterly foliage/trunk source rendering and silhouette.
Existing foliage/limestone rendering; new bed intentionally much lower and irregular.
Actual camera/scale context; controlled frozen environment plate, not normal play.

authority.lead: Originating Audit art direction and game visuals chat
authority.production: Separate production chat owns all game code/integration/engine/Git.
authority.asset_only: Garden folder only: three preserved source PNGs (two logical assets including tree version history), README, manifest and prompts. No product/engine/Git actions.

assets.visual_review: Personally viewed original output with view_image at original detail; no gameplay/runtime/aesthetic approval.
assets.ownership: Outdoor domestic planting. Anchor to actual parcel/ground data. Not a wall-mounted facade texture and not automatically owned by an interior roof cutaway.
assets.occlusion: Production owns placement, sorting, actor visibility and any roof/facade mask decisions. Never infer a collider from canopy, bed perimeter, alpha or this handoff.
assets.processing: No trimming, recoloring, resizing, compositing, alpha cleanup, or re-encoding. PNG copied byte-for-byte.
assets.anchor_method: Manually selected central root-flare contact on actual edited 1254x1254 output, then checked pixel alpha. Short trunk/root partly hidden by foliage. Approximate visual uncertainty +/-16 source pixels.
assets.ground_contact_region_note: Approximate visible root spread, not a collision prescription or calibrated physical footprint.

runtime_sizing.note: Use164 as the lead's existing-interface fitting starting point, preserve source aspect. Native fit is production-owned. Never squash original/v2 vertically to imply overhead projection.

visual_findings.fruit: Muted apple accents and painterly wood/light retained.
visual_findings.projection: Less exposed trunk and more compact crown coverage than v1. Still has a high/triangular lobe and an oblique tall silhouette; not a strict plan-view crown. Single requested edit performed; lead review remains required.
visual_findings.edges: Meaningful alpha>=8 silhouette has44px left/68px top margin. Low-alpha residue outside and warm fine leaf fringes remain. No cleanup.

assets.selection_status: Lead KEEP provisionally as a compact crown/short-trunk candidate for modest native integration testing. No further tree generation before in-game review; no native or final aesthetic approval.

runtime_sizing.note: Uniform scale only. At 100-140 visible width estimated ground depth is about21-29 worldpx; 115 is about24. An 80px width makes ground depth about17 and may be too slight. Ground estimate is visual, not verified engine geometry.

lead_interface_placeholder.status: Existing placeholder dimensions only. Not a distortion requirement. Production must fit geometry to actual source aspect/depth.

actual_source_fitting_at_visible_width_8.note: Actual source bed is substantially shallower than placeholder48–72px depth. Keep natural aspect; production fit pending.

visual_findings.character: One low elongated irregular household planting, visible earth confined to root footprint, loose worn stones, sage/thyme-like groups, muted violet/cream flowers.
visual_findings.projection: Steep down view with shallow south/front edge; taller sage leaf groups remain visually low when scaled as suggested. Actual actor overlap untested.
visual_findings.edges: Faint alpha residue reaches top/bottom rows. Fine leaf/flower detail and warm fringes remain; tiny flower detail will merge at game size.

assets.selection_status: Lead KEEP as a provisional source; not native/fit approval.

verification.method: Read-only Pillow metadata/histograms/pixel samples plus SHA256 comparison of original and selected bytes; personal visual inspection.
verification.visual_check_limits: No game run, engine import, renderer, gameplay scale capture or actor/roof interaction verification was performed. These are source-level observations.
